LESSON: CHURCH UNITY

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 4.3: Church Unity
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Church Unity, part of The Church in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is Church unity important?
